source_comments.raw: # ECB Governing Council scheduled monetary policy decision dates (day the rate decision was announced), January 2010 to December 2026

# Source (all dates through 2026-09-10): https://www.ecb.europa.eu/press/govcdec/mopo/html/index.en.html (per-year listings https://www.ecb.europa.eu/press/govcdec/mopo/YYYY/html/index_include.en.html); a date is included when that day has a press release titled "Monetary policy decisions"

# Source (2026-10-29 and 2026-12-17, not yet held at retrieval): https://www.ecb.europa.eu/press/calendars/mgcgc/html/index.en.html ("monetary policy meeting in Frankfurt (Day 2), followed by press conference")

# Excluded: unscheduled/emergency decisions (2020-03-18 PEPP press release, the only one in the archive listings for 2010-2026), other press releases issued on decision days, non-monetary-policy Governing Council meetings, General Council meetings
# Announcement times (Frankfurt local time; the ECB writes "CET" all year, so this is CEST in summer):

#   2010-01-14 to 2022-06-09: decision press release 13:45 CET, press conference 14:30 CET. Sources: https://www.ecb.europa.eu/press/pr/date/2022/html/ecb.pr220627~73acedf868.en.html ("instead of 13:45"); ECB Working Paper 2281 https://www.ecb.europa.eu/pub/pdf/scpwps/ecb.wp2281~3303fd281b.en.pdf ("at 13.45 Central European Time (CET) a brief press release"); the 2010 releases give the press conference as "2.30 p.m. CET", e.g. https://www.ecb.europa.eu/press/pr/date/2010/html/pr100114.en.html

#   2022-07-21 onwards: decision press release 14:15 CET, press conference 14:45 CET. The first meeting is 2022-07-21, per https://www.ecb.europa.eu/press/pr/date/2022/html/ecb.pr220627~73acedf868.en.html ("Starting from 21 July, monetary policy decisions will be published at 14:15 CET (instead of 13:45)"); still current according to https://www.ecb.europa.eu/press/govcdec/html/index.en.html
